gaps.explanation: Schedule is 234,274 above the statement. The governmental funds statement (p4) prints Total disbursements 654,298 (General column only; Bond '-'; the six function lines add to 654,299) and prints Bond Fund 'Debt service (234,275)' under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES), outside the disbursement total. The Bond Fund budget-and-actual schedule (p9) prints it among DISBURSEMENTS: Debt service - principal 187,909 + Debt service - interest 46,066 + Other 300 = 234,275. Schedule 888,573 - 234,275 = 654,298 = the General Fund combining schedule (p11) and the printed statement total; the remaining 1 is the statement's own line rounding (lines 654,299 vs printed 654,298). No fix.

Schedule is 2,288 short. Proprietary funds statement (p6, accrual): Utility sales 401,487 + Interest income 4,304 = 405,791. Proprietary funds budget-and-actual schedule (p10, 'Actual (Budgetary Basis)'): Utility sales 399,199 + Interest income 4,304 = 403,503 (Transfers from other funds 181,987 recorded as transfers). 401,487 - 399,199 = 2,288. No fix.

Schedule is 13,274 short. Proprietary funds statement (p6, accrual): Total operating expenses 379,635 (incl. Depreciation and amortization 138,237) + Interest expense 31,951 = 411,586. Budget-and-actual schedule (p10, budgetary basis): Personnel expenses 65,987 + Operating expenses 173,076 + Debt service 159,249 = Total disbursements 398,312 (no depreciation; debt service as cash principal and interest). 411,586 - 398,312 = 13,274. No fix.
